name: IRON DISTRICT — Abandoned Steelworks & Freight Yard

effects.description: optional wind / resonant steel; no audio included

integrationNotes: No physics or game controller included.
Grind/coping meshes deliberately excluded from generic collision GLB. Paths supplied for engine-specific grinding.
Main ground and bowl patch share identical boundary positions; collision is a surface triangle mesh, not a convex hull.
Decorative overhead elements are non-collidable. Structural feet and perimeter have visible matching proxies.
Full 200 x 150 m connected floor; scenery beyond boundary is not counted.
Runtime gameplay and frame time require testing in the target engine.
Halfpipe flat bottom is supplied by the underlying slab; coincident bottom contact faces have been removed.
